consequence.statement: A bug fix: RSA 3072 bit key size for TPP certificate enrollment now works; no operator action stated.

original.statement: Venafi vCert library upgrade fixes a bug where RSA 3072 bit key size did not work for TPP certificate enrollment.

decision.reason: [ev-12d2733c5dd3] lists this under "Bug or Regression": the vCert library upgrade fixes a bug that stopped RSA 3072 bit key sizes from working for TPP certificate enrollment. The evidence does not say that anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or must be migrated. An environment that does nothing only gets back a feature that was broken before, so kind "none" (informational) with low severity is supported. behavior-change would overstate it, because no working behavior is described as changing.
